citation: Kasen, D., & Barnes, J. (2019), Radiative Transfer in Kilonovae and Neutron Star Mergers, The Astrophysical Journal, 876(2), 128
model_geometry: 2D axisymmetric multi-dimensional Monte Carlo radiation transport (SEDONA code; Kasen et al. 2006). Toroidal dynamical ejecta + neutrino-driven wind.

physical_assumptions.thermalization_prescription: Barnes, Kasen et al. (2016) time-dependent analytic fit

extraction_protocol: Digitized from Figure 5 (bolometric light curves of 2D dynamical ejecta models) and Table 2 (integrated radiative properties at characteristic epochs). Extracted values represent angle-averaged bolometric luminosity.

points.extraction_provenance: Kasen & Barnes (2019) Figure 5 (t=0.5d early diffusion rise)
Kasen & Barnes (2019) Figure 5 / Table 2 (t=1.0d peak bolometric diffusion)
Kasen & Barnes (2019) Figure 5 / Table 2 (t=2.0d post-peak cooling)
Kasen & Barnes (2019) Figure 5 / Table 2 (t=3.0d transition to optically thin)
Kasen & Barnes (2019) Figure 5 / Table 2 (t=5.0d nebular decay phase)
